snapshot.title: TESS candidate classification UI in scanner station
snapshot.description: When a player views a TESS Planet Candidate (disposition=PC) in the scanner station, they should be able to classify it as 'Planet' or 'Not a Planet'. This unlocks a bonus reward on mission completion.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Planet Candidate targets show 'Classify: Planet' and 'Classify: Not a Planet' buttons in AsteroidDetailView
Confirmed planets (KP/CP) and asteroids do NOT show classification buttons
Submitting a classification saves verdict to RocketsManager state keyed by tic_id
Player sees confirmation text after classifying (e.g. 'Classification submitted — bonus reward unlocked')

changes.newValue:
## Summary
- AsteroidDetailModel.is_candidate(): true for telescope-tess with no confirmed disposition
- AsteroidDetailView._build_classification_row(): adds Planet/Not-a-Planet buttons dynamically
- _on_classify(): stores verdict in RocketsManager + submits to Supabase classifications table
- Buttons show prior verdict if already classified; confirmation text appears on submit
